title: Fennel Pasta with a Chilli-Citrus Crumb
description: The caramelised fennel adds a mellow sweetness to this pasta recipe, while lemon zest and chilli add a little zing. Vegetarian.

items.name: Olive oil (2 tbsp for the fennel, 1 tbsp for the crumb)
Large fennel bulb, finely sliced (green fronds reserved to serve)
Thyme leaves (half for the fennel, half for the crumb)

steps.title: Caramelise the fennel
steps.body: Warm 2 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan, then fry the fennel and shallot with a pinch of salt over a medium-low heat for 40-50 minutes, stirring regularly, until the fennel turns a deep gold and is very soft, almost like a paste. Keep adding splashes of water or the pasta cooking water if it's starting to stick to the pan.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.body: While the fennel cooks, cook the pasta following pack instructions until al dente. Keep back a cup of the cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.body: Once the fennel has caramelised, add the garlic, pine nuts and half the thyme, and fry for 1 minute.

steps.title: Deglaze with wine
steps.body: Pour the wine over the fennel and bring up the heat slightly. Bubble for a few minutes until evaporated while you make the crumb.

steps.title: Make the chilli-citrus crumb
steps.body: In another frying pan, heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil over a medium heat and fry the remaining thyme and the chilli for a few minutes until fragrant. Stir in the breadcrumbs and fold into the spiced oil for a few minutes until they start to turn a little golden. Transfer to a bowl and stir through the lemon and orange zests.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.body: Tip the pasta into the fennel pan, with a splash of the cooking water, and toss well. Serve in warmed bowls with the crumb scattered over the top and the reserved fennel fronds.

notes.label: Cook's tip
notes.body: A mandoline will make short work of shaving the fennel as thinly as you can. When prepping, don't be too quick to discard the green fronds, which can be used as a garnish.

notes.label: Reader tip
notes.body: One reviewer suggests using two large fennel bulbs next time, and adding a squeeze of lemon at the end to lift it.
